title: Draft operator procedures and rescue/evacuation guide
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. RAS adds steps for operators: checking clipped-in status, module requirements per ride class, release under load, and rescue from an inverted stop (REQ-O1, O3, O6, O7, H23).
objective: Draft an operator procedure (pre-dispatch checks, indicator reading, refusal criteria) and a rescue guide (inverted stop, release order center then sides, rider support before release, cut-point backup), clearly marked as a DRAFT template for a ride's own procedures.
acceptanceCriteria: States that primary-restraint checks are unchanged and come first
Every step traces to a REQ or hazard ID
No instruction implies RideBelt can be used today; DRAFT banner
Merged as DRAFT only; release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
